title: SQL Injection
description: SQL injection occurs when untrusted input changes the structure or meaning of a dynamically constructed SQL statement.
indicators: untrusted values passed into raw query APIs
query structure controlled by request data
prevention: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements so data remains separate from SQL code.
Allow-list dynamic identifiers that cannot be parameterized.
source: OWASP Top 10:2025 A05 Injection (https://top10.owasp.org/2025/A05_2025-Injection/); OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/SQL_Injection_Prevention_Cheat_Sheet.html); MITRE CWE-89 (https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/89.html)
